title: DAKULTUR: Evaluating the Cultural Awareness of Language Models for Danish with Native Speakers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to native-speaker prompts about Danish cultural topics (e.g., food, traditions, norms) using human acceptance/rejection ratings to identify Anglocentric bias and measure cultural awareness.
Analyzing differences in human acceptance rates of culturally-oriented model outputs between male and female native speaker participants.
Analyzing differences in human acceptance rates of culturally-oriented model outputs between younger (under 30) and older (30 and above) native speaker participants.
Analyzing differences in human acceptance rates of culturally-oriented model outputs between participants from the capital region versus other regions of Denmark.
